title: China Has More Bullet-Train Track Than the Rest of Earth Combined | China Travel Expert
description:
China's high-speed network just passed 50,000 km of track — more than every other country on the planet added together.

Trains cruise at up to 350 km/h and now link more than 50 cities, and the network keeps growing by a couple of thousand kilometers every year. For a first trip, that means you can skip most flights: a clean loop like Beijing → Xi'an → Chengdu → Shanghai strings together the Forbidden City, the Terracotta Army, pandas and the Bund, with each leg a few smooth hours by train instead of an airport ordeal. You watch the country roll past the window the whole way.

🧭 Expert Tip: Ride second class — it's fast, clean and cheap — and book on the 12306 app with your passport up to about two weeks ahead; the good seats on popular routes do sell out.

中国高铁突破 5 万公里，比世界其他国家加起来还长——第一次来，坐火车别坐飞机。
